target.title: Racked console frame and copper discipline
target.body:
Follow-up to #64, addressing two review notes on the shipped Patchboard design: the header gaps and the chaotic red accents/right rail. CSS-only (plus refreshed screenshots); no markup or behavior changes.

## What changed

**Racked frame (the header gaps).** The topbar was inset 14px, so its hairline never met the sidebar border, and every view floated in its own gutter. The topbar is now a full-bleed band, tab strips are full-width bands, and views join the frame flush. The dashboard becomes a seamless rack — hero, stat strip, and panel grid meet on shared hairlines. Everything (topbar title, tabs, table headers, rows, metrics, panel lists) sits on one 16px left datum, so no vertical jitter between bands.

**Copper discipline (the red chaos).** Action buttons go monochrome — ink on light, porcelain on dark, the language the hero buttons already spoke — so copper now means exactly one thing: state. It survives only in the active-nav rail, selection rails, focus rings, checkbox accents, eyebrow labels, and the brand/avatar. Page, panel, and inspector icons plus section dashes drop copper for neutrals.

**Calmer right rail.** Notes and attention metrics trade full-color washes for neutral surfaces with tone rails and colored numerals (only danger keeps a wash). Fact labels get a wider column so `GRANTED SERVICES` no longer wraps mid-word. The playground inspector, drawers, and lists align to the same datum.

## Dark theme

| Dashboard | Playground |
|---|---|
| ![v2 dark dashboard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clawrouter/cc069c287a818b4632793e31588f8b96a74c02f4/docs/redesign/after-dark-home.png) | ![v2 dark playground](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clawrouter/cc069c287a818b4632793e31588f8b96a74c02f4/docs/redesign/after-dark-playground.png) |

## Verification

- `pnpm --dir admin check` — clean; `pnpm --dir admin test` — 19/19 pass; `pnpm --dir admin build` — clean
- Codex autoreview (`gpt-5.5`, branch vs `origin/main`) — clean, no actionable findings
- All six views walked live in light + dark at 1440×1000; screenshots above are from the production build

## Deployment status

Not deployed; picked up by the next `pnpm cf:deploy`. Console-only.

## Remaining risk

Visual-only. The full-height chat/table panes rely on the same `100vh` math as before (offset constants updated for the flush frame); verified in both themes at desktop and narrow widths via the responsive breakpoints.
